title: The Version of Events You Are Working From Gets Tested
body:
A gap is opening between how a situation has been described and how it is actually unfolding. Pressure is building to check the story you have been operating on against what is verifiably true.
Action: Name one assumption you are treating as fact and check it against a source outside your own narrative.
notes: Converted from predictive_window_blocks.json. Routes on legacy leading_index.
